nativeReader.closeButton: Verhaal sluiten; minWidth/minHeight 48 dp; leaveReader library invalidates pending play callbacks
nativeReader.focusReview: onLayout entry and scheduled frame both require the current reader content key; an obsolete layout event cannot cancel the new focus frame. Passage title host ref receives AccessibilityInfo.sendAccessibilityEvent(focus), then scrollTo(y:0,animated:false).

modeScrollClamp.confirmedNativeCause: Installed ReactScrollView.kt lines1193-1211 clamps currentScrollY to getMaxScrollY on child layout; lines751-754 define maxScrollY=max(0,contentHeight-viewportHeight).
modeScrollClamp.implementation: On mode switch set content-container minHeight to ceil(currentScrollOffset + measuredScrollViewViewportHeight), with nonnegative refs updated by onScroll/onLayout. Ordinary content grows naturally above that floor. No empty play container or second scroll view.
modeScrollClamp.reservedSpace: Only max(0,offset+viewport-naturalContentHeight), at most <1dp extra rounding. Never captures the full outgoing play-scene height.
modeScrollClamp.reasoning: contentHeight >= offset+viewport => maxScrollY >= offset, so shorter mode cannot clamp the current offset. The unchanged choice header/mode button stays at the same content position.
modeScrollClamp.reset: Floor and remembered offset reset to zero immediately on valid choice, restart, story open and reader leave; keyed layout scrolls the newly committed passage to top.
